summary: The Beaches of Agnès is a 2008 French documentary directed by Agnès Varda. It is an autobiographical essay in which Varda revisits places from her past, reminisces about her life, and celebrates her 80th birthday on camera. Varda said it would most likely be her last film, but she went on to release the documentary Faces Places a decade later.
one_line: A 2008 French autobiographical documentary by Agnès Varda revisiting her past and celebrating her 80th birthday.
